records.body: Starting from the latest governed checkpoint produced by run 20260422T161806Z-subsim_lane_soak-6b13aa, executed three iterations of rl-rssm-v2-contact-binding-refinement followed by rl-rssm-v2-soak using each iteration's clutter governance update. Final-cycle trust-aware breakdown stayed stable at validated_non_pass_total=0, monitored_non_pass_total=1 (family clutter_false_positive_heavy), regression_cycle_non_pass=0.
records.summary: Ran a bounded 3-iteration contact-binding refinement + soak verification loop for clutter_false_positive_heavy. Each iteration still early-stopped medium soak on repeated monitored non-pass cycles while validated regression remained clean.
